source_transcription.title: Constituency Level Results for Kenya Presidential Election 2022 - Public Tally
source_transcription.role: Secondary public transcription of constituency-level IEBC Form 34B totals. It is never authoritative over the official IEBC registered-voter schedule or a directly inspected Form 34B.

geography_attachment.method: Exact normalized constituency-name attachment to the canonical registry; no fuzzy matching and no parent inheritance.

requirements: Source row maps uniquely to one canonical constituency by exact normalized name or an enumerated alias.
Source registered-voter value equals the official IEBC constituency total aggregated from the official ward schedule.
The sum of the four presidential candidate vote fields equals the transcription's IEBC total valid-vote field.
Rejected ballots must be explicitly present; null or blank rejected-ballot values are never treated as zero.
Valid votes plus rejected ballots do not exceed official registered voters.
No source boundary pcode, county total, parent value, fuzzy match, interpolation or model is substituted for constituency evidence.

hold_policy: A held constituency receives no turnout series or observation until its direct official Form 34B resolves the discrepancy. Holds remain P23 unresolved and are not converted to an official-unavailable closure.
